title.narrative: UNWomen effectively leverages and expands its partnerships communications and advocacy capabilities to increase support for and financing of the gender equality agenda while securing sustainable resourcing for the delivery of its own mandate

description.narrative: Under this output Cluster UN Women Rwanda Country Office will strengthen collaborations with traditional and nontraditional partners including through dialogue platforms and lessons learned sharing targeting such as Civil Society Organizations academic institutions sport institutions women and youth networks the private sector eg mining sector and other strategic partner institutions including FIsIFIs to promote collaborations that drive the implementation of GEWE initiatives
